title: Mayta, Tamera M, Order on Review
text:
In the Matter of the Compensation of
TAMERA M. MAYTA, Claimant
WCB Case No. 22-03168
ORDER ON REVIEW
Dunn & Roy PC, Claimant Attorneys
Cummins Goodman et al, Defense Attorneys
Reviewing Panel: Members Ceja and Curey.
Claimant requests review of Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) Otto’s
order that upheld the self-insured employer’s denial of claimant’s new or omitted
medical condition claim for a left shoulder rotator cuff tear and AC joint post-
traumatic arthropathy. On review, the issue is compensability.
We adopt and affirm the ALJ’s order.
ORDER
The ALJ’s order dated May 16, 2023, is affirmed.
Entered at Salem, Oregon on January 4, 2024
